LanguageData.NR_Courier: A fixer's courier, {0}, is passing through with hot data ({2} cyberdata) and will stay for a day. Mercenaries are already on the way for it.\n\nYour choice: keep {0} on their feet and the fixer pays goods worth {1} silver and remembers it; or take the data yourself. If the courier dies, the cyberdata is yours, but the job fails, the trail leads to you and the fixers will not forget.
LanguageData.NR_CourierDone: {0} left with the data; {2} is grateful (+{3} reputation). Choose the payment, worth about {1} silver; it arrives by drop pod.
LanguageData.NR_CourierLost: {0} did not make it. The data is gone, and the trail leads to your colony.
LanguageData.NR_CorpHuntIntro: A corporate team has come for your AI server. Defend it: they will try to carry it off or wreck it.
LanguageData.NR_BlackMarketLetter: For {0} days the black market is open to those fixers trust: black braindance, AI fragments, sometimes more. Open: {1}.
LanguageData.NR_DistressFragment: {0} pulled an AI fragment out of the old server.
LanguageData.NR_DistressBacklash: The old server hit {0} with ICE backlash.
LanguageData.NR_MapHackLetter: Hackers have taken over {0} turrets and switched them off. A counter-hack node is in the Gateway for {1} hours: dive and exit cleanly to take them back.
LanguageData.NR_CounterHackWon: The counter-hack worked: your turrets are online again.
LanguageData.NR_CourierOfferText: A fixer asks you to shelter a data courier for a day. The courier carries hot data, and mercenaries will follow {1}-{2} hours after the courier arrives.\n\nKeep the courier alive and the fixer pays goods worth {0} silver (silver, gold, a prosthetic, exec chips or cyberdata, of your choice) and remembers it. Refuse and the courier goes to someone else; nothing is lost.
LanguageData.NR_CourierDeclined: The courier has gone to another colony.
LanguageData.NR_CourierNoWay: The courier could not find a way to your colony.
LanguageData.NR_CourierBusy: A courier is already under your roof: the fixer sends no second one until the first is gone and the hunters are dealt with.
LanguageData.NR_StarterCrate: {0} found a hidden stash in the crate: {1} more cyberdata. A start for the net.
